Welcome
Experience the magic of Southern Africa, whether hunting or just breaking away from city life to listen to the wind, or the howl of a jackal. Neuhof Safaris is a family operated  game farm located in the eastern side of Namibia . Established in 2005, Neuhof aims to provide a personalised hunting and recreational experience.
Activities includes  rifle and bow trophy hunting ,  game drives ,  bird watching ,  photo safaris, hiking trails, horse riding, flight safaris, excursions to see local Bushmen and local wildlife sanctuaries . Satisfy your senses with homemade family cuisine,  bush dinners , Savannah grassland picnics  and sun-downers from the waterhole viewpoint. A variety of  Wellness treatments  are also available.
Neuhof Safari’s hospitality awaits you , offering a home away from home to pursue grander ambitions, giving you a chance to explore life of Africa and the possibility of hope that you will find to fall in love with adventure, freedom and experience.
The experience I had with Neuhof Safaris was life-changing. I cannot say enough about the professionalism, hospitality, and genuine friendship I felt with the entire Neuhof team. Not once did I feel like a 'client' but a member of the family. The knowledge I gained from the team dramatically improved my own skills. There is not a day when I don't think about my next trip to Neuhof. It can't come soon enough.
Tom Leonard, Colonel, US Army (Retired)

Accommodation
Neuhof Safaris accommodation consists of a double story thatch roof lodge and three chalets.
ELEPHANT'S DEN
Double story thatch roof lodge:
2 Bedrooms (1 Double, 2 Twin)
1 Bathroom with a shower
Fully equipped kitchen (Self-Catering option)
Upper level lounge, dining area & indoor bbq
Terrace and balcony
Air-conditioned
Sleeps max 6 adults
Tea/coffee making facilities
Safe deposit boxes
This unit could be booked as a complete self-catering option
MEERKAT MANOR
Three Chalets:
1 bedroom with ensuite bathroom
Air-conditioned
Each chalet sleeps max 2 adults
Tea/coffee making facilities
Terrace facing a waterhole
One wheelchair friendly chalet
Safe deposit boxes
AMMENITIES
Neuhof Safaris provides a communal lounge and dining area equipped with an African bar  and  braai (bbq) area  where hearty meals can be enjoyed three times a day whilst discussing hunting and safari tales. Enjoy an ice-cold beer or an elegant glass of wine alongside.
Relaxing at the crystal-clear swimming pool  may just be what you need to round off an exhilarating day out in the Namibian sun and  unspoilt bushveld.
Neuhof Safaris also offers a Doctor/Family Physician on site.
DAILY ACCOMMODATION RATES
180 Euro pp/night includes activities (exception: Flight Safaris and Health and Skincare treatments)
Rates include:
Accommodation-thatch roof lodge and chalets
Laundry & cleaning services
Three delicious meals (evening meals consisting of appetiser, mains & desserts)
Good selection of red & white wines (Daily: 1 bottle per couple)
Variety of beers and soft drinks (Daily: 6 units per couple)
Slow-roasted-beans coffee, selection of tea and juices
AIRPORT TRANSFER RATES
120 Euro per group
Rate include:
Airport assistance in the arrival/departure
Travel between Neuhof Safaris Lodge and Windhoek Airport (Hosea Kutako)
